**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: Either a documented no-build decision or a qualified implementation is delivered; no automatic expansion occurs.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] Either a documented no-build decision or a qualified implementation is delivered; no automatic expansion occurs.
- [ ] With commissioned probes a saturated zone suppresses eligible drip conservatively, without duplicate dispatcher/firmware control.
- [ ] Missing/failed sensors, reboot, manual rescue and maximum limits remain safe; physical enablement waits for commissioning.
